name: hyperframes
description: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
one_liner: Turns a simple webpage-style description into an actual finished video — titles, animations, charts and all — so an AI assistant can produce a video without touching video-editing software.
buyer: A marketing manager or solo content creator who needs quick product-intro or data-explainer videos but has no video editor on staff and no time to learn one.
business_use_cases: A SaaS marketing team auto-generates a short product-update video every release by describing it in HTML and letting the AI agent fill in the content.
A financial newsletter turns its weekly data into animated chart videos for social media without hiring a motion designer.
A course creator builds a video series by describing each lesson as HTML slides with voiceover timing, rendering a finished video automatically.

money_ideas.idea: Build a hosted 'describe it, get a video' SaaS on top of the open-source renderer, charging per rendered minute of video.
Sell a library of ready-made HTML video templates (product demo, data chart recap, testimonial) to marketers.

steal_this: This weekend, build one polished 'weekly stats recap video' template wired to a spreadsheet input, and sell it as a per-video service to small newsletters or social accounts.
